def: a sailor (as engaged on the salt water), i.e. (by implication) a fisher

occurrences.text: And he saith unto them, Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.
And Jesus said unto them, Come ye after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men.
And saw two ships standing by the lake: but the fishermen were gone out of them, and were washing their nets.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
